newsitem.title: USA: Allied Products major order from GM.
newsitem.headline: Allied Products major order from GM.

text.p: Allied Products Corp said Tuesday its Verson division has received a major order from General Motors Corp to design and build a series of large transfer presses for the automaker's stamping facilities.
Allied Products said that to date in 1997, its Verson division has received new equipment orders of more than $100 million and that this order is a sizable portion of that total.
Allied Products said this order will generate profits into the next century.
The transfer presses ordered by General Motors, all of similar design, are of the type used to manufacture medium to large, class "A" automotive surface panels.
The company also said it continues to bid for about $1 billion in additional orders in the growing market for transfer presses.
Allied Products produces large metal forming presses, agricultural and landscape maintenance equipment, and thermoplastic compounds and additives.
Shares of Allied Products were trading up two to 32.
